messages:
sam: Quick thought  can we add tiny acceptance hints in the approval strip for each diff? e.g. '97% pass, 0 failed assertions' as a muted line so reviewers don't have to open details.

oliver: Sounds useful. Keep it minimal so people aren't biased. Maybe show only when criteria are met or borderline.

meera: Agree. Proposal: show a muted two-line hint under the title: left = short criteria summary, right = 'why suggested' icon that opens the full rule. In compact mode hide the hint.

a11y-bot: Accessibility: the hint text must be readable and announced. Use aria-describedby linking the strip to the hint. If the icon opens a dialog, ensure focus moves into it and there's a close.

analytics-bot: We'll need events: hint_shown, hint_expanded, hint_compact_toggled. include run_id and diff_id.

sam: Keyboard flows: Tab to the diff -> hint focus -> press Enter to open rule details. Show "Press Enter to open" on focus only.

oliver: Copy for muted hint should be short: "97% pass • 0 fails" (visible), tooltip: "Pass rate 97%; no failing assertions; suggested for approval". Screen reader gets full sentence.

meera: Bulk approve implication: if any hint shows a borderline flag, block bulk approve and show a subtle banner explaining why. Banner copy: "Bulk approve paused: 2 diffs need manual review" with CTA 'Review'.

a11y-bot: Also add aria-live polite updates when bulk action availability changes.

sam: Action items: meera mock small strip, oliver draft tooltip + SR copy, dev team to plumb analytics. I'll upload mocks later today.

oliver: will post copy variants in 30m.

meera: mock uploaded: https://redwood.design/links/approval-hint-strip. comments welcome.

sam: thanks all — aiming to ship as an experimental flag behind "inline-criteria". :rocket:
